name: sol_integrations_ac_7
description: Incorrect implementation of AAVE/Compound reward claim logic causes users to receive wrong rewards.
question: The source file in `source` integrates with AAVE or Compound and implements a reward-claiming function (e.g. claiming COMP/AAVE incentives) whose logic incorrectly computes, tracks, or distributes accrued rewards, such as claiming into the wrong recipient, using stale/incorrect accrual amounts, failing to update per-user reward accounting after a claim, or omitting a call to claim rewards where required, causing users to receive incorrect (too much, too little, or no) rewards; this excludes protocols that do not integrate AAVE/Compound reward mechanisms at all, and excludes admin-only reward sweep/rescue functions intentionally restricted to a trusted owner.
criteria: claimRewards() sends the claimed AAVE/COMP tokens to a hardcoded or incorrect address instead of the user who accrued them
Reward accrual mapping (e.g. userRewards[msg.sender]) is not reset or updated after transferring rewards, allowing repeated claims of the same amount
Reward index/exchange rate used to compute a user's claimable amount is read before updating global accrual state, resulting in stale reward calculations
Wrapper contract collects AAVE/COMP rewards for pooled deposits but never forwards or exposes a function letting individual depositors claim their share
claimRewards() uses total contract balance instead of the per-user accrued amount when calculating the payout
